# Third-party notices

<!-- Generated by scripts/runtime/third-party-notices.mjs from pnpm-lock.yaml (sha256 60206325e068e0c7ec351d043722c2d964647d7b9bd170cb2663c4a13c97a335). Do not edit; run `node scripts/runtime/third-party-notices.mjs` and verify with `--check`. -->

The OODS Foundry runtime (`oods-foundry-runtime.tar.gz`, which the npm package `@oods/foundry` carries) ships 453 third-party npm packages: the production dependency closure of the MCP server, the stdio adapter and the HTTP bridge, resolved from `pnpm-lock.yaml` and listed with integrity hashes in `runtime-sbom-lite.json`. Each package stays under its own license, reproduced below from the files published with it. The OODS Foundry license (the Apache License 2.0, see `LICENSE`) covers OODS Foundry itself and none of these packages.

## Declared licenses

| License | Packages |
| --- | --- |
| MIT | 323 |
| BSD-3-Clause | 43 |
| ISC | 43 |
| Apache-2.0 | 27 |
| BSD-2-Clause | 5 |
| BlueOak-1.0.0 | 5 |
| 0BSD | 2 |
| (MIT OR CC0-1.0) | 1 |
| CC0-1.0 | 1 |
| MPL-2.0 | 1 |
| Python-2.0 | 1 |
| Unlicense | 1 |

Packages that publish no license text carry their declared identifier only: `@bundled-es-modules/deepmerge@4.3.1`, `@bundled-es-modules/deepmerge@4.3.2`, `@bundled-es-modules/glob@13.0.6`, `@bundled-es-modules/memfs@4.17.0`, `@bundled-es-modules/postcss-calc-ast-parser@0.1.6`, `@esbuild/darwin-arm64@0.25.10`, `@esbuild/darwin-x64@0.25.10`, `@esbuild/linux-arm64@0.25.10`, `@esbuild/linux-x64@0.25.10`, `@jsonjoy.com/json-pointer@1.0.2`, `@nodable/entities@3.1.0`, `@radix-ui/react-compose-refs@1.1.2`, `abstract-logging@2.0.1`, `change-case@5.4.4`, `glob-to-regex.js@1.2.0`, `is-mergeable-object@1.1.1`, `path-unified@0.2.0`, `pgsql-ast-parser@12.0.2`, `railroad-diagrams@1.0.0`, `stream@0.0.3`, `vega-functions@6.1.1`, `vega-selections@6.1.2`.
